summaryZh: Bilingualism in Context 实验室研究语言经验差异如何体现语言认知系统的适应性。团队围绕生态情境中的问题开展跨地点、多模态实验，结合眼动追踪、瞳孔测量和 EEG。

evidence.quote: The Bilingualism in Context Lab is founded on the philosophy that variation in language experience is a fundamental aspect of language as a cognitive system. We are uniquely positioned to lead in this endeavor, integrating ecologically grounded questions and multimodal experimental approaches in multiple sites around the world. Our approach is transdisciplinary, cross-cultural, and translational.
Bilingualism in Context (BIC) Lab Principal Investigator: Anne Beatty-Martinez

Our research strategy is meticulously crafted, weaving together ecologically grounded multimodal design into a variety of behavioral and cognitive neuroscience techniques (e.g., eye-tracking, pupillometry, and EEG).
We understand that variety in language experience offers the opportunity to explore the adaptive potential of the human mind and brain in all its richness.
